notes.title: Software Update 0.23 - Released
notes.notes:
Thanks for all the early feedback, stay tuned for updates in the next few days. Your input will definitely help make GoatPunks the best it can be.

Updates: 
- beginner, advanced, and king difficulty settings.
- ninja punk skill fixed
- bombs active only at target and not when falling.
